observations.summary: Kimi publishes automatic non-deduction/refund language for certain product failures (monthly credit-pool products: Agent, Deep Research).
Other Kimi official pages describe a request-and-verification path with a deployed anti-abuse verification gate (thumbs-down report flow). Applicability of O1 vs O2 unresolved.
Case A: failures surfaced to the customer as failures with automatic customer-facing refund messaging. Adjudicated label: AUTOMATIC CUSTOMER-FACING REFUND NOTICE; backend restoration UNVERIFIED.

No applicable failure-restoration rule identified on the specific Anthropic pages reviewed (Pro, Max, error pages). Recoded per final review: NO_PUBLISHED_PATH; support outcome UNKNOWN. Not evidence that no path exists.
Kimi customer-visible per-task usage telemetry exists (named task-level percentages, including 0% entries, in owner-supplied screenshot descriptions).
observations.class: OBSERVED (as displayed; screenshots described, not attached)

observations.summary: Kimi Code source-verified behavior: a non-auth provider failure maps to client-visible end_turn (failed -> end_turn), so a detected failure reaches the customer as apparent success. In the same function, auth errors are surfaced loudly via JSON-RPC auth_required (the deployed fail-loud counterexample). Strongest behavioral artifact of the presentation divergence.
Claude Code /usage missing-bars report (#53735). Adjudicated label: reported silent unavailability of usage display; mechanism unverified; not equivalent to O6's source-verified mapping.
observations.class: OBSERVED as external report; mechanism UNVERIFIED

observations.summary: Two longitudinal self-recorded silent-nonconformance series exist (Cases C and C-2): the customer, not the system, detected the failures.

Customer detected 2 of 4 specific documented in-issue error events (C-2 A5-A8). Adjudicated: a count over four events from one model, not a rate; qualitative finding: customer detection remained necessary even inside a three-model adversarial review.

Published pricing text describes fine-grained, dated, per-feature deductions (Claw sandbox approx. 0.6%/day settled 16:00; website hosting approx. 0.08%). Supports a feasibility inference for receipts.
observations.class: DERIVED from published text; ledger UNVERIFIED

observations.summary: Within-provider documentation inconsistency on two independent axes: charge treatment (2v2 domain-family split) and history depth (1v2; 'Showing last 1000 records' interface statement, pending screenshot custody). Adjudicated: a documented ambiguity/disclosure inconsistency; whether it is a legal/contractual/engineering defect is not adjudicated.

hypotheses.name: actuarial_absorption
hypotheses.note: Providers may absorb failure costs silently. Routes to disclosure requests and post-cutoff instrumented trials.

hypotheses.name: disclosure_lag
hypotheses.note: Publication divergence does not establish implementation divergence; non-publication is weak evidence about mechanism.

hypotheses.name: unit_geometry_friction
hypotheses.note: The register contains no published failure rule for any time/window-geometried entitlement from any provider. Geometry per adjudicated correction: Kimi Code rolling 5-hour window (new plans); rolling 5-hour plus weekly limit (legacy plans).

hypotheses.name: gaming_exposure
hypotheses.note: The deployed thumbs-down verification gate is a live anti-abuse answer.

hypotheses.name: presentation_layer_loss
hypotheses.note: Failures detected internally can be lost before the customer surface (O6 source-verified; O7 reported). Adjudicated scope: explains the presentation divergence; publication and telemetry divergences remain under H1-H5. Basis for the fail-loud standard requirement.

customer_burdens.summary: The customer finds the failure (O8, O9); for O6/O7-class events the system hides a failure it detected — burden imposed by system behavior, not customer omission; design intent not established.
Full range populated on this record: AUTOMATIC (O1/O3) / ON_REQUEST with verification gate (O2) / NO_PUBLISHED_PATH with support outcome UNKNOWN (O4; Cases C, C-2).
New chat, lost context, elapsed time, deadline risk; no credit treatment restores these.

Corrective turns may consume the same finite allowance; marginal debit and resulting spend UNMEASURED. A purchasable-credit pathway exists (balance 0, 100-credit monthly limit visible); no purchase observed — the pathway's existence is the finding.

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: consistent_publication
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: Publish consistent, product-, plan-, and entitlement-specific failure rules; inconsistency across a provider's own pages is itself a disclosure finding (O11).

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: per_execution_receipt
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: Durable, exportable per-execution receipt: dispositions, charge treatment, metered units, timestamp, uncertainty/posting delay. Merged with requirement 8's objective-linked layer for bounded tasks (Kimi S1).

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: no_silent_success_mapping
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: Never map a known failure to unqualified success (O6; provider's own review rule names silent failure the most severe class).

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: fail_loud_usage_display
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: Usage displays must surface failures, not silently omit them (O7).

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: verified_dispute_path
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: Contestable disposition path for customer-asserted nonconformance (D3 class), with anti-abuse verification (deployed precedent: O2). Never conditioned on pre-declared acceptance criteria (Claude objection 7).

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: restoration_not_remedy_disclosure
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: Credit restoration does not reverse lost time, context, deadlines, or side effects; disclose this rather than hiding it.

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: geometry_complete_rules
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: Publish failure treatment per entitlement geometry — monthly pool and time/window limits (H3 gap).

proposed_standard_eight_requirements.name: objective_linked_accounting
proposed_standard_eight_requirements.summary: For bounded agentic deliverables with disclosed acceptance criteria: record EXECUTION_ENDED / ARTIFACT_PRODUCED / CRITERIA_VERIFIED / CUSTOMER_DISPUTED as separate states; NOT_DECLARED never defaults to verified; a SUCCESS/end_turn signal alone must not imply a conforming deliverable. Optional extension, not a universal subjective-refund trigger (ChatGPT F6).
